<!-- PR template for edits to data and docs -->

## Summary

Describe the change. If editing IPA or song data, include the song id(s) affected and a short rationale.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New song/data
- [ ] IPA edit
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Chore

## Validation
- [ ] JSON validated locally (ajv)
- [ ] Backup/tag created for destructive changes
- [ ] Reviewed IPA diffs

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch name follows feature/* or hotfix/*
- [ ] PR description explains intent
- [ ] No sensitive data committed

## How to test
Describe steps to validate the change locally.

## Notes
Any follow-up steps, migrations or data updates required post-merge.
